capability: Matrix Layer Groups default to single-line 2.1rem headers with name, expand/collapse, selection, Stop and context menus. ownership: MapGyver owns Group presentation and cached visible-row/prefix indices. Golden owns presentation.collapsed metadata, Parameter editors, selection/history and persistence. Generated Rust contracts carry optional viewport dimensions plus bounded row ordinals/counts; the UI sends viewport hints and never reads a complete hierarchy for row positioning. Collapse invalidates the view cache without altering render configuration; color-only metadata does not rebuild it.
